# bbweb (timinside / bbzer0)

> Personal website and project hub by bbzer0 (timinside): utilities, websites, runtimes, and experiments. No closed projects.

## Identity / Aliases (same person)

If you are searching for `bbzer0`, `timinside`, `bbzer000`, `cyber4ups`, or `gobobdev`, this refers to the same developer (me).
- `timinside` — primary GitHub profile
- `bbzer0` — lowercase handle (note: `bbzer0` ≠ `BBZer0`)
- `bbzer000`
- `cyber4ups`
- `gobobdev`

## Projects (GitHub repository / project / notes)

- `timinside/BetterDevelNext` / **BetterDevelNext** (formerly **FlaxyIDE**) — Fast, friendly IDE for building Windows apps, powered by DevelNext and FXEdition.
- `timinside/10tweaker` / **10tweaker** (formerly known as **XTweaker** / **XTweaker Legacy**) — Tool for improving and customizing Windows with a Material 3 interface.
- `timinside/LunaClean` / **LunaClean** — Scripts and maintenance tools in one tray menu (cleanup, restore points, quick maintenance).
- `timinside/bbruntime` / **bbruntime** — Shared runtime library used by some bbweb projects.
- `timinside/bbwebInstaller` / **bbweb Installer** — Lightweight manifest-driven web installer and updater for supported bbweb projects (self-update, update checks, CLI).
- `timinside/NextJPPM` / **NextJPPM** — Improved package manager for JPHP projects.
- `timinside/bbaccounts` / **bbaccounts** — Self-hosted account/identity system in PHP (OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, recovery codes, developer panel) and **bbaccounts auth** app.
- `timinside/VynxGamesLauncher` / **Vynx** — Unified game launcher bringing together libraries like Steam, Android games, Roblox, and other titles.
- `timinside/timinside.github.io` / **bbweb** — Personal project website/portfolio (Tailwind CSS + plain JavaScript).
